note: Tre transizioni simmetria-crescente di anilinio tetrafluoroborato (AnBF4) fra 130 e 490 K, polimorfi A-D, osservate in VT-PXRD (20 K/h), DSC (5 K/h in riscaldamento) e dielettrica. I CCDC sono 4 per 6 datablock (global, qehweg_a, qehweg_b, C_1, d6b_01628_415K.raw_1, D_1, d6b_01628_480K.raw_1) e non si possono attribuire alle forme. Non sono eventi: la dinamica dell'anilinio e dei BF4− vista al ssNMR (13C a 293, 373, 423, 473 K; 19F una sola risonanza per fase), lo scattering diffuso nel cristallo singolo di C a 430 K, e l'assenza di isteresi ferroelettrica a temperatura ambiente («hysteretic behaviour indicating ferroelectricity could not be observed at room temperature»). La transizione C -> D non e' stata raggiunta nella misura dielettrica (limite 420 K).

forme.citazione: AnBF4 is stable as polymorph B between ∼341 and ∼403 K and the structure was solved at 360 K using SXRD. This revealed a structure in P212121 with unit-cell parameters a = 7.3841 (3) Å, b = 6.1477 (3) Å and c = 18.4441 (8) Å

citazioni: Upon warming, a phase transition occurs at about 341 K.
We label the sequence of polymorphs as A (monoclinic, 130 to 341 K), B (orthorhombic, 341 to 403 K), C (orthorhombic, 403 to 454 K) and D (orthorhombic, 454 to >490 K).
Data were collected between 130 and 490 K with a warming/cooling rate of 20 K h−1 and a collection time of 28 min which corresponds to a pattern being recorded every 9.33 K.
The sample was sealed in a 0.7 mm external diameter borosilicate capillary to a length of 30 mm, and was spun at ten rotations a minute during the measurements.
Polycrystalline samples were prepared by gentle grinding of the crystals.
The monoclinic angle β changes abruptly from 95.4° to 90° at the transition temperature (see the inset of Fig. 3 ▸), further evidence for the discontinuous nature of the transition.
The reversible behaviours seen in Fig. 2 ▸ and in the DSC measurements show that no change in sample composition occurs during any of these transitions.
These transitions are driven by molecular displacement (A→B) and order–disorder (B→C→D) of both the cation and the BF4− anion.

The smaller hysteresis of the second two transitions and the less dramatic changes in the diffraction data suggest that two higher temperature transitions are weakly discontinuous whereas the first is strongly discontinuous.
eventi.note: Monoclino (P21) -> ortorombico (P212121), raddoppio dell'asse c. «Molecular displacement» (A→B) reso con meccanismo displaciva. Temperatura 341 K in riscaldamento a 20 K/h; il testo la dà come «about 341 K» (passo di misura 9.33 K).

gruppi_coinvolti.citazione: The main difference is the ordering of the anilinium ions from two orientations to one, which removes the symmetry planes of the Pmmn space group.
Due to the reduction in symmetry, the number of orientations of BF4− decreases from 16 to 8.
The 16 potential orientations of the BF4− ions when viewed together show little anisotropy suggesting the BF4− anions are freely rotating in this phase.
These transitions are driven by molecular displacement (A→B) and order–disorder (B→C→D) of both the cation and the BF4− anion.
